final: WITH album_rates AS (SELECT AlbumId, COUNT(*) AS track_count, SUM(CASE WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN Bytes END) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN Bytes IS NOT NULL THEN Milliseconds END) AS rate FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId), mean_rate AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS rate FROM album_rates) SELECT AVG(a.rate) AS average_rate, AVG(a.track_count) AS average_track_count, AVG(a.rate - m.rate) AS average_amount_above_mean FROM album_rates AS a CROSS JOIN mean_rate AS m WHERE a.rate > m.rate
